section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study that aimed to replicate and extend previous work on the relationship between connectedness to nature and body appreciation, and to examine associations with nature exposure and other body image-related variables. An online sample of 399 U.S. women and men (mean age = 34.55 years) participated. Path analysis revealed direct and indirect associations between nature exposure, connectedness to nature, and body appreciation, mediated by self-esteem in both genders, and additionally by appearance investment and internalization of a muscular ideal in men.
